gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-stack-sans-head: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strands of identical width, with tips that never drift toward closing up, while Stack Sans Headline sits below. Its wide gaps keep tiny sizes crisp.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-sofia-sans-semi-conden: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Goldman spreads wide, round letters like open parentheses above it, so the heading feels loud and the text stays tight and quick.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sono: Grandstander runs one stroke width through the whole alphabet, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Sono follows with wide default spacing and ajar lowercase a shapes, so paragraphs move at an unhurried, spacious pace.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-stack-sans-notch: Gugi's lowercase climbs almost to the capitals, with terminals cut open. Stack Sans Notch is the quieter partner: Gugi makes a loud, odd entrance, while the plain sans hands over rod-straight, open text that you can see right into.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-stack-sa: Expressive and loose, Love Ya Like A Sister barely lifts its ascenders. Stack Sans Text meets that handmade bounce with big-bodied lowercase and marker-like lines, so one feels scrawled with attitude and the other feels tidy and modern.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sulphur-point: Metamorphous spaces its letters generously, with a high midline and a soft shift between fat and slim strokes. Sulphur Point holds a flat, marker-like line with bulky lowercase, so a long passage feels sturdy and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-offside-gf-ruda: Wide-tracked and stubbornly open, Offside lets its curves refuse to close, while Ruda supplies a wire-thin monoline skeleton and a sizable x-height for screens. One shouts across the room; the other speaks plainly.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-tc: Eater's thin strokes sit beside moderately weighty stems, a thickness shift you feel more than see. Noto Sans TC then steps in with large open counters and outward-opening curves, which gives the dark heading a readable counterweight.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu reads with a high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside. Flavors is the showman, with diagonals as heavy as its stems; the plain sans simply carries the text with quiet, open ease.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham brings open, rounded lowercase with plenty of entry space, a modern and clean foil to Audiowide's tile-like glyphs. A longer passage feels smooth.
